First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Pace isn’t posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you’re new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Biloxi Community Friday Fun Ride group ride

Biloxi Community Friday Fun Ride is a road and social group ride in Biloxi, MS. It rolls every Friday at 6:00 pm from Tri Hard Sports Biloxi (Biloxi Bicycle Works).

A Friday evening community ride from the Biloxi shop at 984 Howard Avenue. The calendar says to check Tri Hard’s Facebook pages for updates, and the shop’s community page lists a Friday Biloxi group ride at 6:00 pm.
